_note: Level templates and the depth bands that levelConstraint refers to. Each level has a fixed number of build slots; growth requires excavating downward, which is expensive, slow, and a structural integrity risk. Per-Shaft level counts live in config/profiles/*.json.

depthBands.name: Upper levels
depthBands._note: Administration, the archive, the grove. Warm, well-aired, and the most desirable place to live — which makes housing allocation political.

depthBands.name: Mid levels
depthBands._note: The bulk of habitation and cultivation.

depthBands.name: Lower levels
depthBands._note: Generator, pumps, reclamation, dig face. toLevel null means 'to the bottom, whatever that currently is'.

zoneAllowances._note: Max slots per zone on one level, or null for unrestricted. Keeps a player from turning one level into an all-industry block and starving its air.

excavation._note: Cost curve for digging a new level. Cost scales by depth via base.structure.excavationCostCurveExponent, so the twentieth new level costs far more than the first.
